theorem_contract.area: area is strictly decreasing off the minimal leaf with logarithmic derivative -H^2
theorem_contract.lifespan: every nonminimal leaf is ancient and collapses at the exact stated finite forward time
theorem_contract.minimal_spectrum: Jacobi operator is Delta+2n, with index n+3 and nullity (p+1)(q+1)
theorem_contract.reduction: y'=2*((p+q)*y-q), with the minimal leaf y=q/(p+q)
theorem_contract.singularity: both focal collapses are Type I with the stated round-cylinder parabolic limits
